import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { EMPTY_STRING, FIRST_ARG_INDEX, MIN_SKILL_BOOK_ID } from '@src/constants';
import App from '@src/response-apps/skillBook/decompose/app';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { withBackendRepeatDetection } from '@src/utils/backendRepeatDetector';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

/**
 * 分解功法指令处理器
 * 指令格式: /分解功法 {功法ID}
 */
const response = onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  const uid = e.uid as number;

  // 解析命令参数（移除命令前缀）
  const messageText = (e.MessageText || EMPTY_STRING).replace(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?分解功法\s*/, EMPTY_STRING).trim();
  const args = messageText ? messageText.split(/\s+/) : [];
  const skillBookIdStr = args[FIRST_ARG_INDEX];

  // 验证功法ID参数
  if (!skillBookIdStr || skillBookIdStr === EMPTY_STRING) {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(`❌ 参数错误

使用方法:
/分解功法 [功法ID]

示例:
/分解功法 123   ← 分解储物袋中ID为123的功法

💡功法ID为储物袋中功法的编号
💡只能分解未锁定、未学习的功法
警告: 分解功法会永久删除该功法，但会返还功法残页`);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const skillBookId = parseInt(skillBookIdStr, 10);

  if (isNaN(skillBookId) || skillBookId < MIN_SKILL_BOOK_ID) {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(`❌ 参数错误

功法ID必须是大于0的数字

示例:
/分解功法 123   ← 分解储物袋中ID为123的功法`);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  // 调用数据层
  const request = createBackendRequestContext(e);
  const result = await App({ messageText: e.MessageText, bid, uid, skillBookId, request });

  switch (result.code) {
    case 'NO_SKILL_BOOKS': {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText('储物袋中没有功法\n\n💡请先获取功法');
      md.addNewline();

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '❌', content: md, footer: [{ label: '储物袋', command: '/我的储物袋 功法' }] }));

      return;
    }

    case 'NOT_FOUND': {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText('❌ 功法ID错误');
      md.addNewline();
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText(result.data.message);
      md.addNewline();
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText('💡请使用 /我的储物袋 功法 查看功法ID');

      md.addNewline();

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md, footer: [{ label: '查看储物袋', command: '/我的储物袋 功法' }] }));

      return;
    }

    case 'FAILED': {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      const displayMsg = await withBackendRepeatDetection(bid, uid, e.MessageText, result.data.message, request);

      md.addText('❌ 分解失败');
      md.addNewline();
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText(displayMsg);

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    case 'LOAD_FAILED': {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(result.data.message);

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    case 'OK': {
      // 构建成功消息
      const refundInfo = result.data.result.refundInfo;
      let successMessage = `✅ 分解成功

【${refundInfo.skillBook.name}】
类型: ${refundInfo.skillBook.skillType}
品级: ${refundInfo.skillBook.grade}
境界: ${refundInfo.skillBook.realm}`;

      // 返还详情
      successMessage += `\n\n📦 折算经验: ${refundInfo.totalExp}`;
      successMessage += `\n└─ 基础返还: ${refundInfo.baseExp}`;

      // 返还的功法残页
      if (refundInfo.items && refundInfo.items.length > 0) {
        successMessage += '\n\n获得功法残页:';
        refundInfo.items.forEach((item: any) => {
          successMessage += `\n  • ${item.name} x${item.quantity} (${item.expValue}经验/个)`;
        });
      }

      successMessage += '\n\n💡功法已被分解，可通过 /我的储物袋 功法 查看剩余功法';

      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(successMessage);

      md.addNewline();

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md, footer: [{ label: '查看储物袋', command: '/我的储物袋 功法' }] }));
    }
  }
});

export default response;
